name: Simultaneous MMSI spoof (the encore)
description: Two synthetic vessels, ~40 km apart, both broadcast the same MMSI from t=0 -- physically impossible for one vessel, so one broadcast is spoofed. Runs on the identical scenario engine as s01 with zero code changes; the only difference is data. If Raj's JTMS (justification-based truth maintenance) is wired in, retracting the false 'one vessel' belief should cascade into two independently tracked identities instead.

expected.retraction_cascade: expected only if JTMS is implemented (Raj); if not, spoof_detected alone is the pack's minimum bar
expected.notes: Both actors broadcast display_id mmsi:412345678 from t=0. Ground truth keeps them as distinct actor keys (vessel_a, vessel_b) throughout -- the spoof is a display-identity collision, not a measurement-identity collision, consistent with the no-identity-on-measurement contract.
